name: Wetteri Oyj
summary: Wetteri Oyj functions as an automotive retailer based in Finland. The company deals in both new and pre-owned passenger vehicles, commercial automobiles, and also second-hand heavy-duty trucks. Beyond sales, Wetteri Oyj provides a range of after-sales services, including the supply of spare parts, routine maintenance, and repair workshop facilities. This firm, founded in 1960, maintains its headquarters in Oulu, Finland.
